## About Me

I am a **Web Developer & Designer** focused on creating modern, responsive, and user-friendly websites. I combine coding and design skills to build websites that are visually appealing, functional, and effective.

My work combines technical exploration with a builder mindset: understand the problem, test the system, and share what actually works.
